crossRefs.note: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the…
for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t…

translations.web: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
translations.bsb: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!” the officers answered.
translations.kjv: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
translations.asv: The officers answered, Never man so spake.
